description:
Refresh an agent knowledge source

Re-reads a URL knowledge source from its source page immediately and replaces the stored content with what the page says now. Website sources are also re-read on a schedule, so this is for the case where a page changed and the agent should know about it at once. Only entries of type `url` can be refreshed; text and file entries are rejected with 400. The entry must belong to this agent and to the account behind the key, otherwise the request is rejected with 404. This endpoint takes no request body.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.

knowledgeId.description: Identifier of the knowledge entry to refresh.

name: refresh_agent_knowledge
title: Refresh an agent knowledge source
